description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the savings account balance and transaction reversal functionalities in the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup for test environment, creating clients and savings accounts, performing transactions, reversals, and assertions on account balances.

classes.name: SavingsAccountBalanceCheckAfterReversalTest
classes.description: This class contains JUnit integration tests for savings account transactions, including deposit, withdrawal, reversal, and balance verification in the Apache Fineract platform.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes RESTAssured configuration and sets up helper objects before each test.

methods.name: testSavingsBalanceAfterWithdrawal
methods.description: Tests that after depositing and reversing a savings account transaction, the account balance is correctly updated to zero and further withdrawal attempts fail due to insufficient funds.

methods.name: testSavingsBalanceWithOverDraftAfterWithdrawal
methods.description: Verifies that reversing a withdrawal with overdraft enabled restores balance correctly, and subsequent withdrawals reflect the overdraft balance.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountDailyPosting
methods.description: Helper method to create and activate a savings account with daily interest posting.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountDailyPostingWithOverDraft
methods.description: Helper method to create and activate a savings account with daily interest posting and overdraft enabled.

methods.name: createSavingsProductDailyPosting
methods.description: Creates a savings product with daily interest calculation and posting periods.

methods.name: createSavingsProductDailyPostingWithOverDraft
methods.description: Creates a savings product with daily interest calculation, posting, and overdraft feature.
